source_documents.role: The audit records the hidden build prerequisite and names the hygiene scheduler as the owner.
The contributor reference requires build outputs before hygiene but does not identify an aggregate preflight.
The standalone aggregate previously scheduled artifact consumers without a prerequisite dependency.

findings.summary: Standalone hygiene now runs a manifest-output preflight and blocks all hygiene leaves until the required build outputs are present.
findings.limitations: The preflight proves output presence; publint and the NodeNext consumer retain ownership of output validity and compatibility. A deliberately cleaned checkout was not mutated because the active worktree contains user changes and ignored build outputs. Fixture tests cover the missing-output path.

changes: Add verify-hygiene-prerequisites.ts to inspect vendor and package manifest-declared lib outputs.
Make the standalone hygiene scheduler run the preflight before every leaf; preserve check:all build dependencies.
Document the preflight and add a bilingual implemented Agent Note.
Add the missing validateMirrorIdentity declaration required by the existing AAA-017 JavaScript verifier tests.

commands: inspect audit, development documentation, and run-gates hygiene ownership

decision.result: AAA-021:A01 PASS — standalone hygiene prerequisite is explicit and fail-fast
decision.diagnosis: The hidden build prerequisite was a repository-automation defect. A preflight is preferable to making hygiene build because it preserves explicit artifact ownership and the existing check:all ordering.
decision.next_action: Complete AAA-021 through the state-last lifecycle and return to AAA-018:A02 while the locale-channel decision remains pending.
